paper_metadata.title: Ferritic Fe–Al–Ni–Cr alloys with coherent precipitates for high-temperature applications

evidence.quote: It is shown that suitable microstructures can be obtained in the Fe–Al–Ni–Cr system with ordered (Ni, Fe)Al precipitates in a ferritic matrix.
